overview: This Senate resolution designates September 2026 as "School Bus Safety Month." It notes that about 26 million students ride school buses on an average school day and that drivers illegally pass stopped school buses tens of millions of times a year, putting children at risk as they get on and off. It describes the safety campaign of a nonprofit called the Child Safety Network, which provides free training and educational videos on bus safety. The resolution aims to encourage public service announcements, recognize bus drivers and safety professionals, and remind drivers to be careful around stopped buses. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on September 30, 2026.
for: Supporters say reminding drivers to stop for school buses and thanking bus drivers can help protect millions of children on their way to school.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic: it does not change any law or provide new funding for school bus safety.
